title:
The Serena-Capriati rivalry was so good. A few notable things...

- they played 7 times at majors, but never a final
- those matches were compressed into a 3-year span
- 6 of those 7 matches went the full 3 sets
- Capriati a rare player with a winning H2H vs Serena at Slams (4-3)
